annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: European Commission's April 2021 proposal for the EU Artificial Intelligence Act, with explanatory memorandum, recitals, articles and financial statement. It sets a horizontal risk-based framework: prohibited practices, high-risk requirements, conformity assessment, transparency duties, sandboxes and governance. AI safety components of machinery, medical devices and other products are integrated into sectoral product legislation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits manipulative AI, exploitation of vulnerabilities, public-authority social scoring and most real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement
High-risk AI systems must meet requirements on data, documentation, transparency, human oversight, accuracy and robustness
AI safety components of products under NLF legislation (machinery, medical devices, toys) are high-risk and checked via existing third-party conformity assessment
Establishes European AI Board, national authorities, EU database, post-market monitoring and incident reporting
Regulatory sandboxes, SME support and voluntary codes of conduct for non-high-risk AI
